QuestInfo.name: Clash of the Xenoroids
QuestInfo.0: Roo-D has something important to tell you.
QuestInfo.1: Roo-D told you that #bBeryl#k has summoned you to the #bSilo#k in the #bClosed Lab#k, where you fought the day you escaped from Gelimer's clutches. This seems to be the #bfinal fight#k. Get prepared, and get to the meeting location.(You can access the Lab via the #bRoad to the Mine 1#k, East of Edelstein.)
QuestInfo.2: This is where everything began, and this is where things will end with #p2159391#.

0.1: I know, I was surprised too. It's from #p2159391#. She wants to settle things with you once and for all. She's claiming she's willing to destroy Edelstein if you don't show up. I think she's pretty serious.\r\n#L0##bI see. I suppose I have to fight her...#l\n#k
0.2: Are you sure this is a good idea? She's pretty mad. You may not come out come back in one piece.\r\n#L0##bWhat are you so worried about?#l\n#k
0.3:
I guess these humans are corrupting my programming, hehe. Anyway, just be careful for me, okay? She sent us the coordinates...

0.4: It's the lab we escaped from. \r\n#L0##bI believe the humans would call this poetic. Beryl must really want an end.#l\n#k
0.5: I'm afraid she does. You can't go into this with any doubts. Let me know when you're prepared, and I'll take you to the lab.\r\n#r(Press Yes to go with Roo-D.)#k

no.0: Don't rush into it. I don't want you getting blown up. I'll take you when you're ready.
